description: Thresholds for the Arkham adaptive-counterparty gate

require_known_counterparty.description: When true, any destination absent from the sender's counterparty history denies outright, regardless of amount.

max_new_counterparty_usd.description: Cap in USD for a payment to a destination the sender has never transacted with. Only consulted when require_known_counterparty is false.

min_counterparty_transactions.description: Minimum number of prior transactions with a counterparty before the relationship counts as established.

max_counterparty_last_seen_days.description: Maximum days since the last interaction with this counterparty before the relationship is treated as stale and requires review.

max_amount_vs_avg_multiple.description: Maximum ratio of the proposed amount to the historical average transaction with this counterparty. 3 denies a payment more than 3x the usual size. Must be greater than zero: a 0 would silently disable the anomaly rule rather than tighten it, so the policy denies as misconfigured_max_amount_vs_avg_multiple.

max_counterparty_concentration_pct.description: Maximum share (0-100) of the sender's recent activity that may be attributable to this single counterparty, catching sudden concentration spikes.

max_outflow_vs_baseline_multiple.description: Maximum ratio of recent daily outflow to the wallet's normal historical daily outflow. 2 denies when the wallet is moving more than twice its usual volume.

max_data_age_seconds.description: Maximum tolerated age of the Arkham observation. A null age fails soft here; list data_age_seconds in deny_on_missing_fields to catch it instead.

deny_on_missing_fields.description: Field names the oracle must actually report. A null on a listed field denies as missing_<field>; unlisted fields fail soft. An empty list opts out entirely. NOTE: Arkham's counterparties endpoint publishes no per-relationship timestamp and no observation timestamp, so counterparty_last_seen_days and data_age_seconds are ALWAYS null today - listing either denies every transaction until Arkham exposes them.
